raw_segments.text: Air, bah, I cannot say it. Well, our ship stopped in the morning before it was quite
daylight at a great city, a huge city with very dark houses and all smoky, not at all
like the pretty clean town I came from, and Mr. Rochester carried me in his arms over
a plank to the land, and Sophie came after, and we all got into a coach, which took us
to a beautiful large house, larger than this and finer, called an hotel.
We stayed there nearly a week. I and Sophie used to walk every day in a great green place
full of trees, called the park, and there were many children there besides me, and a
pond with beautiful birds in it that I fed with crumbs.
